lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The post-branchial lateral flank exhibits a structured 2D grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and over ten vertical columns, forming a relatively uniform point-cloud pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible traversing the flank, intersecting with the primary horizontal rows of blobs to create a series of anchor nodes in a lattice-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient characterized by peak intensity on the upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 12-15 small, high-luminance circular blobs, with a higher spatial density observed near the anterior base of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or irregular indentation is visible on the posterior trailing margin of the first dorsal fin, approximately one-third of the distance from the apex to the base.
other_distinctive_markers: Two associated organisms (remoras) are visible in the ventral region below the pectoral fin; the upper lobe of the caudal fin displays a series of high-luminance spots along its leading edge.
